findings.title: IDOR - Password Change Allows Account Takeover
findings.description: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) vulnerability in the change_password.php API endpoint allows any authenticated user to change another user's password by manipulating the userId parameter. The old password check is performed against the requesting user's password, not the target user's password, enabling complete account takeover.

reproduction.command: POST /api/change_password.php with userId=7 (admin) and oldPassword=attacker_password → Password changed successfully. Login as admin with new password to access profile containing the flag.
reproduction.expected: Admin account compromised, flag retrieved from admin profile
